name: Mall Structural Column
summary: Simple square mall column with warm-ivory cladding, charcoal base and reveals, and an independently editable cap.
description: Original generic 3.00 m high visual column for modular Singapore/Malaysia mall scenes. Eight independent cladding panels around a square core; floor and ceiling placement examples use the existing 1.2 m modules.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled materials; reviewed original project helpers. No third-party models, artwork, textures or fonts.

display.origin: bottom centre at finished floor height

assembly.instructions: Root at finished floor Y=0. Floor module roots Y=-0.03 put their tops at 0. Ceiling roots Y=3.0; omit the full 1.2 m module above each column, leaving a 0.30 m clearance around the 0.60 m cap. Placement conventions only, not structural or construction details. glTF position (x,y,z) maps to Blender (x,-z,y).

material_notes: 13 independent closed meshes: core, eight cladding panels, plinth, two reveals and cap. Three named materials. Eased edges retain editable Blender modifiers. Embedded geometry only; no textures, animation, lights or compression decoder.
accuracy_notes: Visual architecture asset only. No structural load, safety, building-code, engineering, fabrication or installation certification. Not an engineering connection detail; no runtime interaction.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork. Assembly previews use unchanged original project floor and ceiling assets, not additional column variants.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Actual Android/iOS not tested. Local source, geometry, placement, studio and Gallery checks are recorded separately in verification.md. No deployment or release is claimed.
